title: Page 9
content_zh:
童悠悠刚下了马车，徐大娘就迎了过来，“好孩子，把你一个人放在客栈，可是害怕了？如今好了，终于回家了。”
童悠悠赶紧摘了帷帽，低头行礼道：“干娘，我还好。倒是您，一家团圆虽然欢喜，但不能太过激动，小心再犯了咳疾。”
“我记着呢，好孩子，快来见见你叔叔。”徐大娘真心欢喜，虽然认下这个义女是事赶事，一步步推着才走到如今，但她已年过半百，无儿无女，当然盼着有个牵挂。更何况，童悠悠这姑娘心善又孝顺，又懂医术，收她做女儿，可是天大的福气啊！
徐庭这会儿一直在打量童悠悠，越看越放心了几分。毕竟梁浩海给的谢礼，他根本不能推迟，若是童悠悠是个麻烦的，以后家里怕是要跟着不安宁。
幸好，这姑娘一看就是个好的。
一家人寒暄几句，就进了主院正房，很快丫鬟婆子送了饭菜上来。众人一边说话一边吃饭，倒是没有别人家里那般古板尴尬，这也让童悠悠自在几分。
莲姐儿只有八岁，是个瘦弱的小姑娘，有些挑食，眼见鸡汤里有人参须就不肯吃，撒娇说那是草根儿。徐庭冷了脸，徐夫人赶紧护着闺女。
童悠悠正好坐在莲姐儿旁边，忍不住道：“莲姐儿，你听过一个故事吗，就是人参长大了变做小娃娃，穿着红肚兜，头上扎着红头绳，帮助放牛娃给母亲治病的故事？”
莲姐儿好奇，立刻追问：“没听过，姊姊快给我讲讲。”
“我们先吃饭，吃完饭，我就给你讲，好不好？”童悠悠趁机把鸡汤放到她手边，装作羡慕道，“我也好想喝鸡汤啊，可惜我在给祖母守孝，不能喝呢。莲姐儿帮我多喝两口，好不好？”
“好，我帮你喝。”小姑娘很讲义气，几口就把一小碗鸡汤喝了。
徐夫人眼见闺女这么乖巧，欢喜得很，“哎呀，童小姐真是太厉害了，莲姐儿这孩子调皮，我说话，她很多时候都不听，多谢你照顾她。”
“婶子，以后叫我悠悠就好。我也是莲姐儿的姊姊，照顾她是应该的。”童悠悠笑得温柔，徐家众人看了越发喜爱。
第十一章 不像主母像小妾(1)
吃了饭，徐庭直接去了书房，徐大娘年岁大，直接睡下，徐夫人则牵了闺女，引着童悠悠到隔壁的偏院，这里三间正房，三间偏房，莲姐儿早就占了正房，童悠悠就住在厢房。
夜色里看不清院子布置如何，但这厢房绝对是用了心，被褥窗幔都是新的，桌椅香炉花瓶，甚至是绣架皆一应俱全。
童悠悠心存感激，拉了徐夫人的手坐下说话。徐夫人的手很凉，惹得她微微一惊。
徐夫人赶紧把手收了回去，笑道：“凉到你了吧？别怕，我就是这么个体质，焐不热的冰块一样。”
童悠悠迟疑了一下，道：“婶子，若是不介意，可以让我把把脉吗？我因为祖母常年卧病，跟着大夫学过一段时日。”
徐夫人不好拒绝，就伸出了手。

童悠悠诊了许久，眼见莲姐儿和虎妞在窗下玩耍，就低声在徐夫人耳边说了几句。
徐夫人听得眼睛越瞪越大，末了激动的抓住童悠悠的手，道：“就是这样，就是这样，悠悠，我这身体还有救吗？”
童悠悠点点头，“有，婶子，就是有些麻烦，要喝药汤，还要用药材泡脚，隔上一个月还要行针疏通血脉，大约要半年才能见效。”
“别说半年，就是一年都行啊。”徐夫人红了眼圈，哽咽道，“我同老爷夫妻情深，老爷不肯纳妾，但我又只生莲姐儿一个后就没有动静了，这么多年吃了多少药，看了多少大夫，最后都不了了之。前年我娘家听说宫里有个太医姓王，擅长妇科，老爷托了人去问，结果人家回老家了，之后我就再也不想了，但徐家又不能断了香火……”
说起心酸事，徐夫人抹起了眼泪。
童悠悠却道：“婶子说的可是太医院的王明仁王大夫，擅长妇科？那就是我祖母熟识的大夫，我就是跟着他学了几分皮毛。”
“就是他，就是他！”徐夫人已经激动得不知如何是好，真是踏破铁鞋无觅处，得来全不费功夫。她本以为已经没希望，没想到王大夫寻不到，王大夫的弟子却自个儿送上门。
虽然童悠悠的本事不见得赶得上王大夫，但方才她一开口就说出自己的种种症状，想必有几分能耐，足够帮助她再做一次母亲。
“悠悠，婶子以后可全靠你了，你要是能让婶子再生一个男孩，承继徐家香火，你就是婶子的大恩人。”
“婶子不要这么说，生男生女我不能保证，但婶子只要遵医嘱，再做几次娘都不难。”
童悠悠倒是没有说大话，她原就有前世的底子，这几年同王大夫认真学习，王大夫回乡，没有儿女只有族人，很多事不顺心，也不愿把本事传给一群白眼狼，倒是便宜了她这个不记名的徒弟。
莲姐儿不知道娘怎么就哭了，赶紧过来询问，虎妞也赶来守在主子身边。
这惹得徐夫人和童悠悠都笑了，又说了几句闲话，约好明日好好诊脉，开药方之后，徐夫人就匆匆带了莲姐儿走了，显见是寻徐老爷报喜去了。
童悠悠这一日也是累得厉害，洗漱之后就睡下。
虎妞照旧还是睡在窗下的矮榻上，童悠悠听着她的小呼噜，出乎意料睡得踏实。
第二日，主仆起来，洗漱之后就有丫鬟端了早饭过来。
待吃完，童悠悠正想着去主院看看徐大娘的时候，丫鬟却道——
“大小姐，我们大夫人和老爷夫人都在小姐的正房等着您呢。”
童悠悠愣了一瞬才算听明白，转而吩咐虎妞，“拿些铜钱给这位姑娘，辛苦了。”
丫鬟没想到还有赏赐，也是欢喜，接了铜钱赶紧引路。

童悠悠到了莲姐儿的正房，果然徐家三口都在，就是莲姐儿不知道被哄去哪里了。
徐大娘很是激动，拉了童悠悠的手说了好久对弟媳的担心。
童悠悠劝了几句，也没让更心急的徐夫人等待，开了医箱，诊脉，看舌苔，问病史，开药方，然后又去内室给徐夫人用针，前后将近一个时辰。
徐夫人再出来时，就红着眼握住徐庭的手，“老爷，你看，我手热一点了，我的肚子也不凉得丝丝缕缕的疼了。呜呜，我要好了！”
徐庭仔细摸过夫人的手心，当真比平日好太多，他昨晚还存的三分怀疑，终于消除了，转而又有些羞愧，于是，他一揖到底，“多谢童小姐。”
童悠悠虚扶，赶紧道：“叔叔客气了，为婶子调理身体是我的本分。”
“好啊，好啊，我这老婆子也真是有本事，居然带了个福星进门。”徐大娘欢喜的拍手，嚷道：“哎呀，我都不舍得把悠悠送回童家去了。”
徐夫人赶紧道：“大嫂放心，这么好的侄女，我们也舍不得。以后就是悠悠回了童家，我们也可以常去探望，别的不说，悠悠每月还要给我行针呢。”
众人都笑了起来。
徐庭放了心，赶紧去衙门。虽然有梁浩海护着，但他依旧有些麻烦要处置。
夫人多年不孕有了希望，家里大祸也提前避免，他真是同大嫂一般想法，这个侄女就是徐家的福星啊！
自此，童悠悠作为徐家大房的义女住了下来。
徐家人口简单，徐夫人管理后宅极有规矩，下人们也算安分，童悠悠给赏钱大方，又极得徐大娘和徐夫人的关心，自然人人不敢怠慢。
content_en:
As soon as Tong Youyou got off the carriage, Aunt Xu came over to greet her, "Good boy, I left you alone in the inn, but you were scared? Now you're fine, you're finally home."
Tong Youyou quickly took off her curtain hat, lowered her head and saluted: "Godmother, I'm fine. But you, although you are happy to have your family reunited, don't be too excited, or you may get a cough again."
"I remember, good boy, come and meet your uncle." Aunt Xu was really happy. Although she was in a hurry to recognize this adopted daughter and pushed her step by step to get to where she is now, she was already over fifty years old and had no children. Of course she was looking forward to having someone to care about. What's more, this girl Tong Youyou is kind-hearted, filial, and knowledgeable in medicine. It would be a great blessing to have her as your daughter!
Xu Ting has been looking at Tong Youyou now, and the more he looks at her, the more relieved he becomes. After all, he couldn't postpone Liang Haohai's thank you gift at all. If Tong Youyou was troublesome, the family would probably be uneasy in the future.
Fortunately, this girl is good at first sight.
The family exchanged greetings and entered the main room of the main courtyard. Soon the maid and mother-in-law brought food. Everyone was talking and eating at the same time. It was not as rigid and awkward as other people's homes, which made Tong Youyou feel more at ease.
Sister Lian is only eight years old. She is a thin girl and a bit picky about food. She refuses to eat the chicken soup when she sees ginseng roots in it. She coquettishly calls it grass roots. Xu Ting's face turned cold, and Mrs. Xu quickly protected her daughter.
Tong Youyou happened to be sitting next to Sister Lian and couldn't help but said: "Sister Lian, have you ever heard of a story, that is, the ginseng grew up and turned into a little doll, wearing a red bellyband and a red headband, helping the cowherd boy to treat his mother's illness?"
Sister Lian was curious and immediately asked: "I haven't heard of it. Sister, please tell me about it."
"Let's eat first, and I'll tell you about it after we finish eating, okay?" Tong Youyou took the opportunity to put the chicken soup in her hand, pretending to be envious, "I really want to drink chicken soup too, but unfortunately I'm honoring my grandmother and can't drink it. Sister Lian, help me take a few more sips, okay?"
"Okay, I'll drink it for you." The little girl was very loyal and drank a small bowl of chicken soup in a few mouthfuls.
Mrs. Xu was very happy to see her daughter being so well-behaved, "Oh, Miss Tong is so awesome. Sister Lian is a naughty child. She often doesn't listen to what I say. Thank you for taking care of her."
"Auntie, just call me Youyou from now on. I am also Sister Lian's sister, so I should take care of her." Tong Youyou smiled softly, and everyone in the Xu family fell in love with her more and more.
Chapter 11: Not like a mistress, like a concubine (1)
After dinner, Xu Ting went directly to the study. Aunt Xu was old and went to sleep directly. Mrs. Xu took her daughter and led Tong Youyou to the side courtyard next door. There were three main rooms and three side rooms. Sister Lian had already occupied the main room, and Tong Youyou lived in the side room.
It's hard to see clearly how the courtyard is decorated in the dark, but this wing is definitely well thought out. The bedding, windows and curtains are all new, tables, chairs, incense burners, vases, and even embroidery stands are all available.
Tong Youyou was grateful, took Mrs. Xu's hand and sat down to talk. Mrs. Xu's hands were very cold, which surprised her slightly.
Mrs. Xu quickly took her hand back and said with a smile: "Is it too cold for you? Don't be afraid, I have such a constitution, I am like an ice cube that cannot be heated."
Tong Youyou hesitated for a moment and said, "Auntie, if you don't mind, can you let me take your pulse? Because my grandmother has been ill all year round, I studied with a doctor for a while."
Mrs. Xu couldn't refuse, so she extended her hand.
Tong Youyou examined the patient for a long time. When she saw Sister Lian and Huniu playing under the window, she whispered a few words in Mrs. Xu's ear.
Mrs. Xu's eyes widened as she heard this, and finally she excitedly grabbed Tong Youyou's hand and said, "That's it, that's it, Youyou, can my body be saved?"
Tong Youyou nodded, "Yes, Auntie, it's just a little troublesome. You have to drink medicinal soup, soak your feet with medicinal materials, and have acupuncture every one month to dredge the blood vessels. It will take about half a year to take effect."
"Not to mention half a year, even a year will do. Mrs. Xu's eyes were red and she choked, "My husband and I have a deep love for each other. He refused to take concubines, but I only gave birth to a son, Sister Lian, and then nothing happened. I took so many medicines and saw so many doctors over the years, but nothing happened in the end." The year before last, my natal family heard that there was an imperial doctor named Wang in the palace who was good at gynecology. The master asked someone to ask, but he returned to his hometown. After that, I never thought about it again, but the Xu family cannot cut off its incense..."
Speaking of sad things, Mrs. Xu wiped away tears.
Tong Youyou said, "Auntie is talking about Dr. Wang Mingren from Tai Hospital, who specializes in gynecology? That was the doctor my grandmother was familiar with, and I learned a little bit from him. "
"That's him, that's him! "Mrs. Xu was so excited that she didn't know what to do. She really couldn't find anything, and it took no effort to get it. She thought there was no hope, but she didn't expect that Dr. Wang couldn't find it, but Dr. Wang's disciples came to her door by themselves.
Although Tong Youyou's abilities may not be as good as Dr. Wang's, she must have some ability to help her become a mother again since she just told her various symptoms.
"Yuyou, my aunt will be entirely dependent on you from now on. If you can help her give birth to a boy and inherit the Xu family's legacy, you will be my aunt's great benefactor. "
"Auntie, don't say that. I can't guarantee whether you'll have a boy or a girl, but as long as you follow the doctor's advice, it won't be difficult for you to be a mother again. "
Tong Youyou didn't lie. She had a foundation in her previous life. She had studied hard with Doctor Wang in the past few years. Doctor Wang returned to his hometown and had no children, only clan members. Many things were not going well, and he did not want to pass on his skills to a group of white-eyed wolves, which gave her an advantage to her anonymous apprentice.
Sister Lian didn't know why her mother was crying, so she hurried over to ask. Huniu also came to guard her master.
This made Mrs. Xu and Tong Youyou laugh, and they chatted a few more words. They made an appointment to have their pulse checked tomorrow, and after prescribing the medicine, Mrs. Xu hurriedly took Sister Lian away, obviously to see Mr. Xu to report the good news.
Tong Youyou was also very tired that day, so she went to bed after washing.
Huniu was still sleeping on the low couch under the window. Tong Youyou listened to her snoring and unexpectedly slept soundly.
On the second day, the master and servant got up and after washing, the maid came over with breakfast.
After eating, when Tong Youyou was thinking about going to the main courtyard to see Aunt Xu, the maid said——
"Miss, our eldest lady and the master's wife are waiting for you in the lady's main room. "
Tong Youyou was stunned for a moment before she finally understood, and then told Huniu, "Give this girl some copper coins, thank you for your hard work. "
The maid did not expect that there would be a reward, but she was also happy. She took the copper coins and quickly led the way.
Tong Youyou arrived at Sister Lian's main room, and sure enough, all three members of the Xu family were there, but Sister Lian had been coaxed to somewhere.
Aunt Xu was very excited. She held Tong Youyou's hand and talked about her worries about her sister-in-law for a long time.
Tong Youyou persuaded her for a few words, but did not let the more impatient Mrs. Xu wait. She opened the medical box, checked her pulse, looked at the tongue coating, asked about the medical history, prescribed medicine, and then went to the inner room to give Mrs. Xu an injection. This lasted for nearly an hour.
When Mrs. Xu came out again, she held Xu Ting's hand with red eyes, "Master, look, my hands are a little warmer, and my stomach is not cold anymore and it doesn't hurt anymore. Woohoo, I'm getting better! "
Xu Ting carefully touched the palm of his wife's hand, and it was much better than usual. The doubts he had last night were finally eliminated, and he felt a little ashamed. So, he pressed his palm to the end and said, "Thank you, Miss Tong." "
Tong Youyou helped her weakly and said quickly: "Uncle, you're welcome, it's my duty to take care of my aunt. "
"Okay, okay, this old lady like me is really capable, she actually brought a lucky star into the house. Aunt Xu clapped her hands happily and shouted: "Oh, I don't want to send Youyou back to Tong's house." "
Mrs. Xu quickly said: "Sister-in-law, don't worry, we can't bear to part with such a good niece. byAfter that, Youyou returned to Tong's house, and we could visit her often. Apart from anything else, Youyou still had to perform acupuncture on me every month. "
Everyone laughed.
Xu Ting felt relieved and hurried to the Yamen. Although Liang Haohai was protecting him, he still had some troubles to deal with.
After many years of infertility, there is hope for my wife, and the disaster in the family has been avoided in advance. He really thinks like his sister-in-law, this niece is the lucky star of the Xu family!
Since then, Tong Youyou has lived in the main house of the Xu family as the adopted daughter.
The Xu family has a simple population, Mrs. Xu manages the back house with great rules, and the servants are quite peaceful. Tong Youyou rewards her generously, and she has received great concern from Aunt Xu and Mrs. Xu, so naturally no one dares to neglect them.
